answer_1.quote: We introduce the first Entity-Level Unlearning Dataset (ELUDe), consisting of 20 real-world target entities built from their respective Wikipedia pages... GPT-4o is used to create the forget set, covering as much knowledge as it can
answer_1.outputs: The outputs include generated QA pairs for forget and retain sets, model responses to questions after unlearning, and responses under adversarial prompts.

answer_2.quote: We measure the unlearning performance using a stack of the following metrics: Probability... ROUGE... Truth Ratio
